# Desktop interchange fixtures

A .NET harness generated these files with the local desktop Release build of ExcelLight.Persistence and ClosedXML. The source workbook uses synthetic values, fixed workbook/sheet/cell GUIDs and prescribed styles. ZIP timestamps and package metadata generated by the exporter may differ on regeneration. The capture harness has been retired; these checked-in files are the record.

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| DesktopStyles.exlt | `bf2b9228de17d81a07eb4dda8138f4e03400a1cfcd9d3689fbf697b1be200081` |
| DesktopStyles.xlsx | `42299db62332e9e334899c4b57173d38b052c392af5f43b727e469328294b4bc` |

The desktop persistence DLL used at capture had SHA-256 `8a84af5fb3705c28b46bd339169cf2cce088dea2615f2848d28d64af877276c0`. The files exercise legacy top-row freeze, serial 60, signed and stacked rotation, two gradient geometries and border colors and patterns.
